```{r setup, include=FALSE}
valeur = function(x, defaut = "Non renseigne") {
  if (!length(x) || is.na(x[[1]]) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[[1]]))))
    return(defaut)
  as.character(x[[1]])
}
texte = function(x) {
  x = valeur(x, "")
  x = gsub("\r\n?", "\n", x)
  x = gsub("\\\\par\\b", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
  if (grepl("<[^>]+>|&[A-Za-z#0-9]+;", x)) {
    x = gsub("(?i)<br\\s*/?>|</(p|div|li)>", "\n", x, perl = TRUE)
    x = tryCatch(xml2::xml_text(xml2::read_html(paste0("<div>", x, "</div>"))),
                 error = function(e) gsub("<[^>]+>", "", x))
  }
  lignes = strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lignes = trimws(lignes)
  lignes = lignes[nzchar(lignes)]
  for (symbole in c("\\", "`", "*", "_", "{", "}", "[", "]", "<", ">", "#", "!", "|"))
    lignes = gsub(symbole, paste0("\\", symbole), lignes, fixed = TRUE)
  paste(lignes, collapse = "\n\n")
}
``` 

```{r entete, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("\\gdef\\senateurstitre{", params$titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurssoustitre{", params$sous_titre, "}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\gdef\\senateurslogo{\\raisebox{-8pt}{\\includegraphics[height=0.78cm]{\\detokenize{",
    params$logo, "}}}}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\pagestyle{senateurs}\n")
```

```{r amendements, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
d = params$donnees
x = d[!duplicated(d$uid), , drop = FALSE]
cat("**Recherche :** ", texte(params$sous_titre), "\n\n",
    "**Selection :** ", nrow(x), " amendement(s)\n\n",
    "**Edition :** ", format(Sys.Date(), "%d/%m/%Y"), "\n\n", sep = "")
comptes = function(v) {
  v = as.character(v)
  v[is.na(v) | !nzchar(trimws(v))] = "Non renseigne"
  t = sort(table(v), decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(Categorie = names(t), Nombre = as.integer(t))
}
for (champ in c("etat", "sort", "groupe")) {
  cat("## ", c(etat = "Etats de traitement", sort = "Sorts", groupe = "Groupes politiques")[[champ]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(comptes(x[[champ]]), format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
cat("## Amendements\n\n")
if (!nrow(x)) cat("Aucun amendement dans la selection.\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
  a = x[i, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("### Amendement ", texte(a$numero), "\n\n",
      "**Date :** ", texte(a$date_depot), "  \n",
      "**Auteur :** ", texte(a$auteur), " (", texte(a$groupe), ")  \n",
      "**Etat :** ", texte(a$etat), " ; **Sort :** ", texte(a$sort), "  \n",
      "**Texte :** ", texte(a$texte), " ; **Article :** ", texte(a$article), "  \n",
      "**UID :** ", texte(a$uid), "\n\n",
      "**Dispositif :**\n\n", texte(a$dispositif), "\n\n",
      "**Expose sommaire :**\n\n", texte(a$expose), "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
